findings.evidence: BilinMap.lean:115-117; `bilinMap` is `LinearMap.mk₂ ...` (BilinMap.lean:49-54). Mathlib proves `AlternatingMap.neg_apply` as a `@[simp]` lemma rather than leaving the defeq implicit (upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Alternating/Basic.lean).
findings.fix: Prove it from the `_apply` lemmas, e.g. `LinearMap.ext₂ fun v w => by simp [bilinMap_apply]` (using `AlternatingMap.neg_apply`, `LinearMap.neg_apply`), or keep `rfl` with a comment naming the defeq relied on.
findings.issue: `bilinMap_neg` closes with `LinearMap.ext₂ fun _ _ => rfl`, which only typechecks by unfolding `LinearMap.mk₂` inside `bilinMap` and then both the `AlternatingMap` and `LinearMap` `Neg` instances through their `DFunLike` coercions. None of this is stated or documented, and explicit lemmas exist.

findings.evidence: Tensor.lean:360-365 with `fromG1G2` defined at Tensor.lean:212-214; Tensors/Basic.lean:719-722 and 735-738 with `fromF1F2` defined at Tensors/Basic.lean:621-623.
findings.fix: Make the unfolding explicit before invoking `eq_of_pair`, e.g. `simp only [fromG1G2] at h` (resp. `simp only [fromF1F2] at hzero` / on the two sides in `decomposition_unique`), so the coefficients being cancelled are visible in the proof text.
findings.issue: `hLI.eq_of_pair h` is applied to `h : fromG1G2 ε K g₁ g₂ = fromG1G2 ε K g₁' g₂'`; the metavariables `s, t, s', t'` are solved only by delta-unfolding `fromG1G2` into `(√M/(p·q) * g₁) • E₁ + (√M/(p·q)² * g₂) • E₂`. Nothing in the script says where the subsequent `h1`, `h2` shapes come from. Same pattern at Tensors/Basic.lean:720-721 (`hzero.trans (by simp)` unified against `?s • transverseMetric + ?t • rankOne`) and Tensors/Basic.lean:737-738.

findings.evidence: Tensor.lean:439 `lemma kWit4_p_q : ηWit kWit4.p kWit4.q = 1 := by simp`; grep for `kWit4_p_q` across ./code returns only that definition line, and Tensor.lean:492-493 passes `(by simp)` for the `hpq` argument of `fromG1G2_ne_zero` (Tensor.lean:369-371).
findings.fix: Use the lemma at the call site (`by rw [kWit4_p_q]; norm_num`), or delete `kWit4_p_q` if the `simp` normal form is meant to carry it.
findings.issue: `fromG1G2_kWit4_ne_zero` discharges `ηWit kWit4.p kWit4.q ≠ 0` with an anonymous `(by simp)`, while `kWit4_p_q` states exactly `ηWit kWit4.p kWit4.q = 1` and has no use anywhere in the repo, so the named fact is dead and the call site is opaque.

summary: The prior defeq finding in bilinMap_update_neg is fixed and the determinant/witness proofs are robust. Three smaller issues remain: an undocumented rfl through the Neg instances in bilinMap_neg, three proofs that obtain their coefficients only by delta-unfolding fromG1G2/fromF1F2 during unification with eq_of_pair, and a named witness lemma replaced by an opaque by simp at its only call site.
